description: Fork of exp134 trading nap=8->6 with tph chosen for full (~100%) pair coverage. Same dims (E=64, d_qk=d_v=32, n_heads=6) but 3x cheaper LUT weights vs exp134 at same coverage. qk: nap=6 tph=336 (samples=2016, 100% pool=2016). v: same. out: nap=6 tph=3056 (samples=18336, 100% pool=18336). Per-layer LUT: qk 8.26M + v 4.13M + out 12.51M = 24.90M. 6 layers: 149.4M LUT + ~15M = ~164M total. Tests whether the per-table expressiveness from nap=8 (exp134) is worth 3x the weights at equal coverage.
